plugins.name: pr-relevance-memory
plugins.description: GitHub Actions reusable workflow that records PR comment resolution signals into LoreKit, making the reviewer and pr-reviewer agents continuously more accurate per repository. Install the caller template (templates/pr-relevance-caller.yml) and add LOREKIT_API_KEY to your repo secrets.
